Sara —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass MAP (redwood_map_v1.pdf) and a short SOW draft for the pilot (cartwell_SOW_draft.docx). Key points up front:

- Deliverables: prompt pack (sample subset), curated testcase bundle (200 items), and a sealed sample dataset (anonymized, 10k lines) delivered to an ephemeral sandbox.
- Access model: Ephemeral access via a time-limited sandbox token (30 days by default) — we can shorten to 14 days for the pilot.
- Acceptance criteria: functional (>= 92% on your core BLEU/QA metrics across a 50-case acceptance set) + stability (no serving errors >0.5% during verification runs).
- Use constraints: no reproduction or public redistribution; derivative use allowed only for internal evaluation during pilot; destruction/takedown required within 14 days of pilot end unless a separate license is signed.

Two operational notes:
1) We need a signed mutual NDAs/MPA focused on the sample corpus and promptpacks (we can include a limited-use appendix).
2) For SOC2/security items, send your questionnaire; our security team will upload the evidence bundle.

Proposed short cadence:
- Tue 6/16: finalize MAP and SOW
- Mon 6/22: deliver sandbox credentials + sample pack
- Weeks of 6/22–7/31: pilot (6 weeks)
- 14 days after pilot: takedown window

If that looks reasonable I can circulate a single-sheet MAP for signatures.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
